summary: Full E2E testing of SonicGo F&B ERP (backend + frontend). 22/22 backend pytest tests pass: auth (login, /me, refresh, wrong password), dashboard, sales (Reguler 0% and GrabFood 20% commission), expenses, purchases (create + partial + full pay), inventory (Masuk/Rusak stock adjustment, Transfer, snapshot), foodcost, cashflow report, Excel + PDF export (valid PDF header, xlsx content-type), vendor CRUD, role protection (finance_user gets 403 on POST /api/users, POST /api/seed, GET /api/users; can read /dashboard). Frontend: admin login via httpOnly cookies works, Dashboard shows KPIs with seeded numbers (Rp 63.700.000 sales, 28.86% food cost, low stock alerts, channel breakdown, trend chart), lang toggle switches ID/EN, header-branch-select filters reactively to SC Marabahan, nav across all pages (/sales, /expenses, /inventory, /debt, /foodcost, /reports, /master, /users) works, GrabFood sale created via UI, Excel/PDF export buttons present. Finance user (created via API since UI add-user modal role Select had a click issue in Playwright only, see notes) has role-restricted UI: master/users nav hidden and direct URL /master + /users redirects to / (dashboard).

issues: DialogContent missing Description or aria-describedby (a11y warning in console)

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Users/MasterData dialogs to remove Radix a11y warnings.
Optional: on Users create dialog, the role Select default is already 'finance_user' so UI works; no code change required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 741 lines and mixes auth, models, CRUD, aggregation, reports. Consider splitting into routers (auth.py, sales.py, reports.py) for maintainability once feature-stable.

compute_foodcost() beginning/ending both use $lte relative to start/end without $gt on ending; ending correctly picks last snapshot up to end, beginning picks last snapshot up to start – acceptable but document formula clearly.

generic crud() ignores POST/PUT/DELETE authorization roles; finance_user can modify branches/vendors/products/menus. Product mgmt should likely be admin-only per spec ('super_admin ... + master data'). Currently master data CRUD is open to any authenticated user; role protection only exists for /users and /seed. Recommend adding require_admin to master data mutations.

generic crud() _update replaces the whole document via $set of body.model_dump() which will overwrite Product.stock to whatever the client sends – can silently zero real stock if editing a product without preserving stock. Consider partial update or excluding stock from client payload.

Inventory type='Transfer' does not decrement source stock or increment destination stock; only Masuk/Rusak/Keluar mutate product stock. If TO-TI transfer is meant to move stock between branches, transfer logic is a no-op today.
CORS uses '*' when CORS_ORIGINS is unset while allow_credentials=True – browsers reject this combo. In production ensure CORS_ORIGINS is set to explicit origins.
